en.headline: Huanggang checkpoint sees overnight queues after concert and Halloween events
en.dek: Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki instructed departments to ensure smooth flow after footage showed long vehicle queues at the 24-hour crossing.
body: The new Huanggang Port experienced significant overnight congestion early on Sunday as large numbers of travellers returned to the mainland after attending a concert at Kai Tak Sports Park and Halloween-related activities in the city.

Footage circulated on social media showed extended queues of cross-boundary vehicles on approaches including San Tin Highway, with private cars, taxis and coaches affected. Reports indicated waits of up to an hour or more in places, though queues began to ease around 2 a.m. Huanggang is the only 24-hour land crossing between Hong Kong and Shenzhen.

Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki visited the Shenzhen Bay and Huanggang control points on Sunday and instructed the Security Bureau to continue ensuring port operations remain safe, efficient and orderly. Immigration authorities had earlier indicated higher passenger and vehicle volumes were expected from evening into the early hours.

Operators of cross-boundary coach services reported increased demand from late evening, with some urban boarding points seeing longer lines. Authorities have previously noted that the facility’s one-stop inspection has improved processing compared with the old arrangement, though peak demand can still produce delays.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸深夜至凌晨車流人流倍增 陳國基指示確保暢順
zh.dek: 啟德演唱會及萬聖活動後大批旅客經新皇崗北返，網上片段見車輛輪候，政務司司長已視察並指示保安局跟進。
body: 新皇崗口岸周日凌晨錄得較大車流及人流，主要因啟德體育園演唱會及市區萬聖相關活動結束後，大量旅客經該口岸返回內地。
社交媒體片段顯示，新田公路等接近口岸路段一度出現跨境私家車、的士及旅遊巴士排隊情況，部分位置輪候時間較長，約凌晨2時後開始疏導。皇崗口岸是港深唯一24小時運作的陸路口岸。
政務司司長陳國基周日視察深圳灣及皇崗口岸，並指示保安局繼續確保口岸運作安全、高效及有序。入境處早前已預告黃昏至凌晨人流車流會較多。
跨境巴士營運商表示晚上需求上升，市區部分登車點出現較長人龍。當局指出新口岸的一地兩檢安排整體加快了通關，但高峰時段仍可能出現輪候。
